name: Celia
source:
There may never have been a proper election, but Celia is the de facto Mayor of the household. With her royal mein and withering wit, could you ever vote no? She rises above any sort of corrupting influence and clearly has the best interests of the house in mind. Still, this coy countess does know how to party - she never misses one of her favorite shows at Chairemi's.

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
